In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the protein profile of the plasma in patients with chronic renal failure and hemodialysis differs substantially from that of normal subjects.

in chronic hemodialysed patients, the concentrations of plasma proteins are not only influenced by the severity of renal insufficiency, but also by the presence or absence of complicating factors, such as infection or inflammation.
in patients with chronic renal failure, the plasma concentrations of most proteins are not affected by the renal disease per se, and are not influenced by hemodialysis.
